import numpy as np

# Generate G(200, 0.3) adjacency matrix

adj = np.triu(adj, 1) + np.triu(adj, 1).T  # Make symmetric, no self-loops

# Start with a balanced random partition

partition = np.random.choice([0, 1], size=n)

# Greedy improvement

        # Calculate current contribution to cut

                if (1 - partition[v]) != partition[u]:

        # Flip if it improves the cut
        if flipped_cut > current_cut:
            partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]
            improved = True
    
    if not improved:
        break
